fields.title: Break Down Time
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Screen opens in 3.2 s. Known: 5 sequential requests, RTT 130 ms, total server processing 900 ms, response 620 KB, speed 1.5 Mbps, rendering 250 ms, cold start adds 200 ms.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: What will yield the biggest gain?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: network 5 × 130 = 650, server 900, transfer 620 KB / 1.5 Mbps ≈ 3.3 s — here is the problem, the numbers do not add up, meaning transfer happens in parallel with something or speed is higher. Even at twice the speed, transfer ≈ 1.6 s — the largest component. The biggest gain is reducing response size, then combining five requests into one. Server optimization is third, though people usually start with it.
